title: No 0.7.0 compatibility layer in the transition
question: What does the owner's statement that 0.7.0 does not exist (M14, M15) change in P2?

options.text: Implement the reference exactly, without compatibility shims: no class aliases or deprecated members; 0.7.0 fixtures are regression guards of current behavior that an item updates deliberately in the commit that changes the pinned format; a short migration instruction for AI agents (docs/upgrade.md, section 'From 0.7 to 1.0') replaces the machine upgrade map; reference values win over 0.7.0 code where P1 found a difference
Keep the revision-2 compatibility promises (upgrade map with rename paths, 0.7.0 snapshots unchanged except mapped entries)

context: P2 design session. P1.2 recorded differences between knowledge/identities and the 0.7.0 code (system actor type, unenforced azguard/* prefix, exit codes not routed through one attempt(), an unlisted Filament doctor check). The owner rejected compatibility with 0.7.0 and asked to follow the recorded design.
decision: A — Implement the reference exactly, without compatibility shims: no class aliases or deprecated members; 0.7.0 fixtures are regression guards of current behavior that an item updates deliberately in the commit that changes the pinned format; a short migration instruction for AI agents (docs/upgrade.md, section 'From 0.7 to 1.0') replaces the machine upgrade map; reference values win over 0.7.0 code where P1 found a difference
rationale: Owner: 0.7.0 does not exist as a constraint, build the ideal reliable API by the recorded design, and provide a short migration instruction for AI agents (M14, M15). Reference values are the design; shims would add concepts without purpose (principle 5).
consequences: The plugin id prefix azguard/* is enforced at compilation: only a plugin class declared under the AzGuard\ namespace may use it, any other raises PluginConflictException (code plugin_conflict).

Every AzGuard console command runs its body through CommandSupport::attempt(): exit 0 success, 2 input/panel/tenant/identity errors, 1 other errors (knowledge/identities#commands); commands.json is updated deliberately.
The system actor type is the reference value azguard:system (knowledge/identities#resources); ActorRef::SYSTEM_TYPE changes with its snapshot.
filament.definitions (FilamentDefinitionsCheck, finding ids filament.missing_definition, filament.stale_definition) is an identity owned by Filament in addition to knowledge/identities#doctor.
The azg_ grant-field prefix is reserved without a rename path; defaults.gate.mode is removed and rejected by the generic unknown-key validation.
P1 snapshot writers may run on the changed tree (P2.1 relaxes the 0.7.0-tree guard to an explicit write switch); every fixture change is listed in the item result.
knowledge/upgrade-map is the input list of symbol changes for the migration instruction, not a deliverable file.
P3 and P4 design sessions must re-evaluate the 0.7.0 installation/adoption scenarios of D11, B18 and release-gate condition 5 under M15; P2 does not change them.
